description:
Outcome: Verified first version becomes available in production, from brief.md / First version 1–4 and owner decisions.
Scope: Deploy O-verified release, backup before migration, production sign-in/scheduler smoke checks and documented rollback. Excludes: plot map/grid, payments, tool lending, attachments, public contact directory.
Acceptance: O passes before release; production operational smoke evidence recorded.
Behaviour: Rollback/recovery available for failed deployment. All interfaces use phone-friendly large text, plain language, accessible labels and keyboard operation; server-side role/household authorization.
Verification: Deployment, smoke and rollback checklist with evidence. Prerequisites: T-014. Assumptions: Editable March 1–October 31 defaults; garden timezone configured; coordinator-confirmed households; application receipt timestamp plus stable sequence for ties; preferences advisory; no automatic vacancy-offer expiry; 09:00 daily digest without empty emails. Framework/providers and finite retention periods settled in A/N. See setup handover.
title: Release verified application
